hook.say: This morning, the post said voice AI still breaks on context, speed, transcription and trust, so demos still do not translate into production. I went back in to check the numbers around that.

findings.label: LATENCY
findings.headline: GPT Realtime 2.1 still answers slower than Azure
findings.detail: Same benchmark also shows Azure at 1.66 seconds median.
findings.say: First, in Cekura’s live-call benchmark, GPT Realtime 2.1 needed 1.94 seconds median to answer, while Azure Realtime came in at 1.66.

findings.label: STALLS
findings.headline: OpenAI still went silent on 3.3% of calls
findings.detail: Cekura counts a stall when the agent is silent for 10 seconds or more.
findings.evidence: The agent went silent for 10 seconds or more on 2.0% of Gemini 3.8 Live calls and 3.3% of GPT Realtime 2.1 calls.
findings.say: Second, even a strong model still stalled: GPT Realtime 2.1 went silent on 3.3% of calls, versus 2.0% for Gemini 3.8 Live.

findings.label: COST
findings.headline: Published call cost is higher than a cheaper rival
findings.detail: Cekura lists vendor-published per-minute rates for the same benchmark setup.
findings.evidence: GPT-Live 1 + GPT-6 Sol (low thinking) costs $0.055 a minute of call and GPT Realtime 2.1 $0.085
findings.say: Third, cost still matters: in that benchmark setup, GPT Realtime 2.1 was priced at $0.085 per minute, versus $0.055 for GPT-Live plus Sol low.

take.headline: Good voice is not enough
take.say: My take: if latency, stalls and cost still move this much, the bottleneck is the system, not the voice demo.

caption:
This morning’s post said voice AI still breaks on the basics that block scale: context, speed, transcription and trust. I went back in and checked the numbers around that.

1.94s median reply time for GPT Realtime 2.1, versus 1.66s for Azure Realtime.
3.3% stalled-call rate for GPT Realtime 2.1, versus 2.0% for Gemini 3.8 Live.
$0.085 per minute for GPT Realtime 2.1 in Cekura’s setup, versus $0.055 for GPT-Live + Sol low.

My take: good voice is not enough. If the system is still slower, stalls more, and costs more, production will expose it fast.

Comment SDR and I will send you the details by DM.
